reason: Reading one Instance's pod names, and the Create pass's sweep of pods with no report from their kubelet over a whole Component at rest, every pod Running and reported Ready, under a force-delete policy. Each name is written into one allocation of its own length and the list is sized to the Instance's pods: 2 allocations and 80 bytes for a single-pod Instance at index 3,999, 9 and 640 bytes for a gang of eight, 3 and 160 bytes for a gang of two. The sweep reads an Instance's names only when one of its pods has no report from its kubelet, so at rest it allocates nothing at any shape. Before, each name went through the formatting library (6, 36 and 12 allocations; 144, 1,360 and 320 bytes) and the sweep built every name of the Component on every pass: 23,744 allocations and 527 KB at 4,000 single-pod Instances, 5,760 and 218 KB at 160 gangs of eight, 20,188 and 536 KB at 1,725 gangs of two.
